thread:
Alexandra: Heads-up — co-curated micro-summit with NovaCloud + TensorEdge on May 18. Need final speaker list, 20-min demo slots, and a consolidated swag packing list by EOD Friday. Who can own speaker confirmations?
Maria G: I can handle speaker outreach (NovaCloud & TensorEdge). Will confirm speakers by Thu noon. Need talk titles + 1-paragraph abstracts from partners.
Raj: I'll scope demo infra — planning 2 DGX-ish nodes + 1 edge kit for hands-on pods. If shipping blocked, fallback to cloud-hosted image + remote keyboard control.
Sophie: I'll own swag logistics. Quick Q: budget for co-branded tees + 100 sticker gift packs? Also need lead times for production.
Kevin (Ops): Shipping lead time for international is ~12 business days. Cutoff for May 18: Apr 30 for international, May 6 for domestic. Recommend local pickup at venue for edge kit to avoid customs delays.
Logistics Bot: Reminder: Venue ASNs required 48h prior. Use the template in #logistics -> attachments/ASNs.
Alexandra: Draft schedule proposal: Intro 5m, 3x20m talks = 60m, Panel 15m, Hands-on pods 60m, breaks 15m -> ~145m. Can we compress hands-on to 40m and keep 120m total?
Maria G: Speakers tentatively: NovaCloud — Priya Shah (infra for inference), TensorEdge — Marco Lim (edge quant workflows). Need bios + slides by May 1.
Raj: Demo fallback: container image + prerecorded 10-min walkthrough clip. I'll prep images and a one-page runbook for hosts.
Sophie: Swag baseline: 150 tees (S-XL mix), 300 sticker packs, 40 lanyards, 60 demo loaner stickers, 30 microfiber wipes. Estimated production lead: 10 business days once art approved.
Alexandra: Can someone update the run-of-show doc with exact times? I'll sync with partners Friday 11am PST. Also confirm AV needs: HDMI + USB-C adapters + 1x HDMI capture.
Kevin (Ops): We have 4 AV kits reserved. I'll share the venue contact and arrange local pickup. Also recommend leaving 2 spare power strips.
Maria G: :thumbsup: I'll ping Priya and Marco this afternoon for abstracts and confirm May 1 slide deadline.
Raj: Quick deploy snippet for local fallback: ```docker run -p 8080:80 redwood/demo:2026-05-01``` — includes healthcheck & sample payload.
Sophie: For tees: prefer RHS chest logo + small partner wordmark on sleeve. Will get mockups by Wed. Any color restrictions from partners?
Alexandra: Keep branding subtle — partners ok with small co-brand logos. Also clarify announcement embargo: partners, pls confirm if any embargoes on demos/announcements.
Marco (TensorEdge): Hi all — Marco here. Confirmed: I’ll present edge quant talk and bring 1 dev to run the demo. Slides by 4/28. Embargo ok for event-day announcement.
Priya (NovaCloud): Priya here — will send bio + slides by May 1. Keen to coordinate a joint blog post the week after the event.
Alexandra: Action items recap: Maria — partner confirmations & abstracts. Raj — demo images + 10-min prerecorded backup + runbook. Sophie — swag PO + mockups by Wed/EOD Thu for production. Kevin — AV contact & local pickup. I’ll send calendar invite and partner sync for Fri 11am PST.
Sophie: ✅ ordering tees once art approved, will share production ETA.
Raj: 👍 building container image & recording walkthrough this week.
Maria G: I'll follow up with partners now, tagging them in email.
Logistics Bot: Note: If any item requires customs paperwork, attach commercial invoice to ASN doc.
Alexandra: Thanks team — let's keep updates to the run-of-show doc and drop quick status pings here.
Sophie: Will add swag packing checklist to the doc.
Marco (TensorEdge): See you all on Fri sync.
Priya (NovaCloud): Thanks, closing loop from my side after I upload slides.
Kevin (Ops): Sending venue contact + pickup window in thread doc.
